_evidence: 0x004118dd is a piecewise-linear curve lookup on the table at edx: dword +0 = last point index (signed cmp ecx,[edi] / jle; 0..7 keeps every read inside 0x4c), then points (X_i at +4+8i, Y_i at +8+8i). It finds the first X_i > eax (signed); i=0 returns Y_0, past the last returns Y_last, otherwise (eax-X_{i-1})*(Y_i-Y_{i-1}) idiv (X_i-X_{i-1}) + Y_{i-1}. A curve has strictly increasing X, so each X_i lies in its own band [-10000+2000i, -8001+2000i]: then 0 <= eax-X_{i-1} < X_i-X_{i-1} and |quotient| < |Y_i-Y_{i-1}| <= 2^31 always fits (no #DE); unsorted X can divide by zero or overflow, which no real curve does. Y values are full-range i32.
